title: Port objectstack PR #24886 into guard-main-checkout-bash.sh: a quote inside a "$(…)" is read as closing the outer string, so a read-only curl with a ">" in its JSON body is blocked — the hook pair is declared case-for-case identical
body:
Filing gate ①: a defect with a named location and a reproduction in this repository. It is also the follow-up that accepted work in objectstack owes here (cross-repo rule 3).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24812

**Reader who acts:** the objectui seat that owns `.claude/hooks/**` (routing is triage's), in one PR on `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` and `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh`. Filed by objectstack's `domain:skills` seat 1 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#7623, `session_01M82feuetLzrCiBz41BJb7L`), which accepted the objectstack fix. Unlabelled for domain and grade; those are triage's.

**Dedupe (open and closed), objectui, MCP `search_issues`** (read 2026-10-20T13:28Z): 「guard-main-checkout-bash command substitution quote redirect false block hook」 → 7 hits, all closed. None is this shape. They are earlier ports of the same hook pair and serve as precedent for this card's form: #5459 (quote-escape fix), #5789 (fix family from objectstack PR #11278), #5712 (comment false block), #6042 (stash guard backslash), #8287, #6977 and #3435.

## Why this repository owes it

objectstack's copy of `guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` says in its header (lines 14–16 on `origin/main`): "Ported from objectui's hook of the same name … the logic below is deliberately kept case-for-case identical to it so the two repos' guards cannot drift". objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24886 (for objectstack-ai/objectstack#24812) changes that logic. Once it merges, the two copies differ until this one is ported.

## The defect here, measured

Measured by the objectstack-ai/objectstack#24812 dev at objectui `9eb1479`, with cwd = the primary checkout and the command fed as `{"tool_input":{"command":…},"cwd":…}`. Both of the card's pure-read forms answer exit 2 (blocked):
- `echo "a $(curl -d "{\"c\":\"x > 1\"}" http://h)"`
- `echo "a $(curl -d '{"c":"x > 1"}' http://h)"`

The hook reads a `"` inside a `$(…)` (or a backtick) that sits inside a double-quoted word as closing the outer string. The `>` in the JSON body then reads as a redirect.

## Done when

- The merged diff of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24886 is ported, localised as earlier ports were (issue references, example paths, the package name in the self-test). It is the shared `subst_end()` helper, its call from the three quote-aware scanners (`strip_line_comment`, `split_segments`, `tokenize`), the header lines, and the +11 self-test cases. Port from the merged commit on objectstack `main`, not from the PR head.
- The ported self-test passes, and every existing real-write control stays blocked.
- `guard-shared-stash.sh` is out of scope here. Its defect of the same family is tracked in objectstack as objectstack-ai/objectstack#24901, and its objectui twin follows that card's landing the same way.
